segments.title: ⌘W on the New Tab closes the window
segments.body: Keep Top Apps running is on and a Top App is playing. ⌘W on the window's only New Tab: nightly.7 opened another New Tab every time, so the window never closed. Now it closes on the first press.

segments.title: Settings search finds a shortcut by its keys
segments.body: "cmd opt n" typed into Settings' search. nightly.7 found nothing. Now it lists the command that holds ⌥⌘N and opens Shortcuts filtered to it.

segments.title: Tabs across the top stay readable in a narrow window
segments.body: The window narrowed from 1180 to 760 points. nightly.7 squeezed every title to a few letters. Now tabs that won't fit move into the open tabs menu, and the group shows how many went there.

segments.title: Apple Passwords is an official plugin
segments.body: Settings › Plugins. nightly.7 listed only Command Line. Now Apple Passwords sits under Official, off until you turn it on.
